user.title: Select an OpenRBus gateway
user.description: Select a connectable gateway discovered by Home Assistant Bluetooth, including ESPHome Bluetooth proxies.

credentials.title: Pairing PIN
credentials.description: Enter the installation-specific pairing PIN for {name} ({address}). The current scaffold stores but does not yet use the PIN; OpenRBus 0.3.0 expects an already paired gateway.

access_policy.title: Access policy
access_policy.description: Read-only is the safe default. Enabling writes only opens the integration-level gate; OpenRBus retains its independent safety and access checks, and this scaffold exposes no write service yet.

abort.no_devices_found: No connectable OpenRBus gateway was found.
abort.not_supported: The discovered device does not expose the OpenRBus transparent service.

init.title: Access policy
init.description: Read-only is the safe default. Enabling writes only opens the integration-level client gate and does not bypass any OpenRBus safety check.
